issues.summary: Revert or repoint iptables link: wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo is a 404
issues.detail: docs/reference/configuration-guides/logging.md:16 replaces the help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo URL with https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo, which returns HTTP 404 (no IptablesHowTo page exists on wiki.ubuntu.com). gemini-3.1-pro-preview, deepseek-v4-pro-0813 and kimi-k3 report the original help.ubuntu.com URL still resolves and ask for a revert; claude-opus-5, deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash verified the old URL now 301s to the same dead page (legacy wiki content never migrated), so the link was already broken and should instead point at a live target (e.g. the Ubuntu Server firewall/security docs, the iptables manpage, or netfilter.org).

The maas.io/docs migration is incomplete: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus-without-bmc.md:18 still links https://maas.io/docs/how-to-work-with-tags#heading--automatic-tags, which redirects to canonical.com/maas/docs/stable/how-to-guides/work-with-tags/ and returns 404 (verified live). Convert it to a root-relative internal link like the one added in deploy-dpus.md.

issues.summary: Fix stale Full_Disk_Encryption link at docs/explanation/security.md:110
issues.detail: Same-class breakage outside the diff: docs/explanation/security.md:110 links https://help.ubuntu.com/community/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019, which redirects to wiki.ubuntu.com and 404s (legacy wiki content not migrated). Worth fixing if this PR aims to close out stale links.

issues.summary: Run docs 'make linkcheck'; it flags the iptables 404 and gates this PR
issues.detail: docs/Makefile:108 provides 'make linkcheck' (sphinx linkcheck; linkcheck_ignore in docs/conf.py does not cover these hosts). It reports the wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo 404 as [broken] and exits 1, so it would have flagged the regression before merge and will fail CI as-is; it is the cheapest verification for a link-only PR.

issues.summary: Drop redundant 'MAAS Documentation -' prefix on now-internal link
issues.detail: docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md:425: since the link is now an internal doc reference (/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md), the 'MAAS Documentation \- ' prefix and escaped hyphen in the link text are redundant; simplify to '[How to Manage Machines](/how-to-guides/manage-machines.md)'.

issues.summary: Restore trailing two-space break dropped on deploy-dpus.md:425
issues.detail: The edited line in docs/how-to-guides/deploy-dpus.md lost the trailing two-space hard line-break that the surrounding 'Additional Resources' list items kept. Harmless for rendering in a list, but worth normalizing for consistency.

issues.summary: Tidy UFW link that silently redirects to UFW_development
issues.detail: The adjacent unchanged UFW link on logging.md:16 (https://wiki.ubuntu.com/UncomplicatedFirewall) only resolves by silently redirecting to the UFW_development page; it could be updated to a canonical target in the same pass as the iptables fix.

issues.summary: Leave join-our-forum.md maas.io URL: form prefill, not navigation
issues.detail: The remaining maas.io occurrence in join-our-forum.md is only a Google-Form prefill parameter, not a navigation link, so it is not affected by the maas.io -> canonical.com/maas redirect and can be left out of this PR's scope.
